tooltip: Camera Settings - Provides access to USB Video Class (UVC) controls for image tuning including brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, gamma, gain, white balance, backlight compensation, powerline frequency, zoom, tilt, pan and focus
content1: The Camera Settings allows you to customize USB Video Class (UVC) controls for image tuning including brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, gamma, gain, white balance, backlight compensation, powerline frequency, zoom, tilt, pan and focus
content2: 1. The PropertyRange structure holds information about a control's value range, including its ID, minimum, maximum, current and step, and default values, as well as the control mode (auto or manual). 2. The UsbCameraProperty Enum indicates the specific control for which value has to be extracted.
struct2:
enum UsbCameraProperty {
  UvcPropertyBrightness = 0,
  UvcPropertyContrast,
  UvcPropertyHue,
  UvcPropertySaturation,
  UvcPropertySharpness,
  UvcPropertyGamma,
  UvcPropertyWhiteBalanceAuto,
  UvcPropertyWhiteBalanceManual,
  UvcPropertyBacklightCompensation,
  UvcPropertyGain,
  UvcPropertyPowerLineFrequency,
  UvcPropertyPan,
  UvcPropertyTilt,
  UvcPropertyRoll,
  UvcPropertyZoom,
  UvcPropertyExposureAuto,
  UvcPropertyExposureManual,
  UvcPropertyFocusAuto,
  UvcPropertyFocusManual
};
getAPIDes: This function will get the Camera Control values of the respective control id passed.
setAPIDes: This function will set the Camera Control values of the respective control id passed.

tooltip: Still Capture Settings - Allows you to configure cross-platform still image capture with support for JPEG, PNG, RAW, and BMP output formats.
content1: Allows you to configure cross-platform still image capture with multiple output formats. Captures high-resolution still frames from the video stream and saves them in JPEG, PNG, RAW, or BMP formats across Windows, Linux, and other platforms.
content2: 1. The StillCaptureProperty structure holds information about still capture format, resolution, and file format.
getAPIDes: Result GetStillCaptureProperty(StillCaptureProperty* stillProp) - This function will get the current still capture format, resolution and file format setting. Result GetSupportedStillFormats(std::list<StillCaptureProperty>& formats) - This function will get the supported still capture formats, resolutions and file format options.
setAPIHeading: Result SetStillCaptureProperty(StillCaptureProperty* stillProp), Result CaptureStillImage(const std::string& filepath)
setAPIDes: Result SetStillCaptureProperty(StillCaptureProperty* stillProp) - This function will configure the still capture format, resolution and file format settings. Result CaptureStillImage(const std::string& filepath) - This function will capture a still image and save it to the specified filepath in the configured format and file type.

tooltip: Select video codec format for still capture encoding. H264 provides excellent compression and compatibility, while HEVC offers better quality at smaller file sizes.
content1: Allows you to select the video codec format for still capture encoding. H264 provides excellent compression and compatibility across platforms, while HEVC offers better quality at smaller file sizes on supported platforms.
content2: 1. The camera object stores the still capture format in stillPixelValue field.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current still capture properties including format. The format is stored in cameras[index]->stillPixelValue.
setAPIHeading: int PreviewController::setCurrentStillProperty(int index, const QString& format, const QString& resolution, QString fps, const QString& fileFormat)
setAPIDes: Sets the video codec format for still capture. Pass 'H264' or 'HEVC' as the format parameter.

tooltip: Specify the resolution for still image capture. 3840x2160 (4K) provides high-quality detailed images suitable for archival and detailed analysis.
content1: Allows you to specify the output resolution for still image capture. 3840x2160 (4K) resolution provides high-quality detailed images suitable for archival, analysis, and detailed inspection.
content2: 1. The camera object stores width and height in stillWidth and stillHeight fields after parsing the resolution string (e.g., '3840x2160').
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current still capture resolution. Width and height are stored in cameras[index]->stillWidth and cameras[index]->stillHeight.
setAPIHeading: int PreviewController::setCurrentStillProperty(int index, const QString& format, const QString& resolution, QString fps, const QString& fileFormat)
setAPIDes: Sets the output resolution for still capture. Resolution is passed as a string 'WIDTHxHEIGHT' (e.g., '3840x2160').

tooltip: Choose output file format for saved still images. JPEG: Compressed for web use. PNG: Lossless with transparency. RAW: Uncompressed sensor data for post-processing. BMP: Uncompressed bitmap for legacy compatibility.
content1: Allows you to select the file format for saving still images. JPEG provides compressed format ideal for photos and web distribution. PNG offers lossless compression with transparency support. RAW captures uncompressed sensor data for maximum quality and professional post-processing. BMP provides uncompressed bitmap format for compatibility with legacy systems. All formats are fully cross-platform compatible.
content2: 1. The camera object stores the file format in stillFileFmt field. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, RAW, BMP.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current file format setting. By default, format is set to 'BMP'. File format is stored in cameras[index]->stillFileFmt.
setAPIHeading: int PreviewController::setCurrentStillProperty(int index, const QString& format, const QString& resolution, QString fps, const QString& fileFormat)
setAPIDes: Sets the file format for still image output. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, RAW, BMP. Emits statusChanged signal on success.

tooltip: Apply the still capture settings. Changes will take effect for subsequent still image captures.
content1: Applies the configured still capture settings including format, resolution, and file format. All changes will take effect for subsequent still image capture operations.
content2: This button triggers the application of all still capture configuration changes made through the format, resolution, and file format controls. Internally calls setCurrentStillProperty with all configured values.
getAPIDes: Retrieves all current still capture properties.
setAPIHeading: int PreviewController::setCurrentStillProperty(int index, const QString& format, const QString& resolution, QString fps, const QString& fileFormat)
setAPIDes: Applies all still capture configuration changes. Parses resolution string (WIDTHxHEIGHT), updates format, fps, and file format. Emits statusChanged signal with success message.
